spans.s: 1 कौश॑ f. ई made of Kuśa grass.
2 कौश a. silken.
कौसल m. pl. N. of a people & a dynasty.
कौशाम्बिका f. a woman's name.*
कौशाम्बी f. N. of a town.
कौशाम्बीय a. of or from Kauśāmbī.
2 कौशिक n. a silk cloth.
3 कौशिक m. owl.
कौशीलव n. the profession of an actor or bard.
कौशी˚लव्य n. the profession of an actor or bard.

कौशेय a. silken;
 n. silk, a silk cloth.
कौषारव m. a patron name.
कौषीतक m. patron. names.
कौषीत˚कि m. patron. names.
कौषीतकिन् m. pl. N. of a Vedic school.

कौषीतकिब्राह्मण^1 m. T. of a Brāhmaṇa,
˚णोपनिषद् & कौषीतक्युपनिषद् f. T. of an Upaniṣad.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: Print shows hy, should be hm.
कौष्ठ॑ a. being in the belly or in a store room.

कौसल्यं a. belonging to the Kosalas;
 m. a prince of
the Kosalas, f. आ a princess of the Kosalas, esp. one of the wives of
Daśaratha.
कौसीद f. ई connected with a loan.
कौसुम f. ई made of flowers, flowery.

कौसुम्भ f. ई made of safflower^1, dyed with s., orange,
red.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.

कौस्तुभ m. n. N. of a celebrated jewel, the ornament
of Viṣṇu.
